sentences: Stabbing Planes reasons by branching on linear inequalities to refute integer infeasibility.
The saved question asks whether a refutation measured by length can be simulated with polynomially bounded encoded size.
A short derivation may still contain inequalities whose coefficients require many bits.
A positive simulation would show that line-count efficiency does not conceal an essential numerical blowup in this proof system.
The source excerpt truncates the polynomial's arguments and does not preserve the simulation variant, so those details remain necessary before stating a formal size bound.
